reserveReview.rationale: Current issuer reserve-assets documentation identifies Taikang, ChinaAMC and BNY Mellon money-market fund products. At Ethereum block 26098753 on 2026-10-01, FUSDGateway.lp resolves to 0x3fea1cb36d2c5523c062d0e060eac253608b4daf. Its three configured reserve tokens match the issuer API product-address mapping, and each tracked reserve amount exactly equals that token's balance at reserveTreasury 0x7c2e652f8bb1da76d172e11f8a099c663b3fff54. This independently observed live token inventory supports retaining the coarse 100% fund-share basket with compositionAsOf 2026-10-01; it is not a refresh inferred from a webpage caption or the API's April 21 timestamp. The contract's USD values imply approximately 24.875721% Taikang, 24.807229% ChinaAMC and 50.317050% Finloop/BNY, but those values are publisher-supplied NAV marks rather than an independently reconciled fund report. Configuration updateAt remains April 21 while the price bundle timestamp is October 1. The bundle's PoR values are all zero, and its report forwarder and author/workflow guards are unconfigured. No verified off-chain collateralization, fund-holder priority, underlying maturity or recovery assurance is inferred. Unknown look-through exposure remains 100%.
